detected.detail: reflection gate: T51/T52/T53/T54 require a genuinely empty stock_records table ('no records on the live branch'), but the feature branch DB is shared with S1/S2 specs that seed randomUUID-keyed rows and the build forbids DELETE teardown. The empty state can never be reached reliably on a correct app (passes alone, fails at full-suite verify). Re-author so the empty response is obtained without depending on a globally empty table (e.g. Playwright page.route scoped by URL pathname === '/api/stock-records' returning [] for the empty-state specs, and a component test that supplies an empty list), keeping the real-DB path for populated tests.
detected.resolution: revised by human-proxy: full design re-run (test_list gate)
